patch_description:
The recommendation suggests testing N_REPEATS=2 with an added second cross-YY link. 
Analysis of prior results shows:
- Gen 1 (N_REPEATS=3, depth=12): score=0.43, worst_group_margin=0.25, 9 distinct params
- Gen 2 (N_REPEATS=3, depth=18): score=0.51, worst_group_margin=0.36, 7 distinct params
- Current (N_REPEATS=3, depth=15): score=0.49, worst_group_margin=0.22, 11 distinct params

The current program has too many distinct parameters (11) and a poor worst_group_margin (0.22), 
indicating weak separation on hard samples. Reducing N_REPEATS to 2 will lower depth from 15 to ~10, 
reducing overfitting and improving generalization. Adding a targeted YY gate on qubits (1,3) 
introduces controlled cross-qubit correlation without excessive parameter proliferation. This keeps 
distinct param count low while maintaining expressivity through strategic connectivity. The depth 
reduction should improve the train-test gap and worst_group_margin by preventing overtraining on 
the small training set.
